topic: Classifying Objects as Solid or Liquid
key_concepts: Objects and materials can be classified as solid or liquid.
Different parts of the home contain both solid and liquid objects.
Different places in school contain both solid and liquid objects.
Common household chores use solid and liquid materials.
The sala, kitchen, bedroom, and bathroom each have examples of solids and liquids.
The classroom, bathroom, laboratory, and clinic each have examples of solids and liquids.
Laundry, cooking, cleaning, and bathing a dog involve solids and liquids.
